name: Notion
description: The all-in-one workspace for your notes, tasks, wikis, and databases. Highly customizable for developer documentation and project tracking.

name: Trello
description: Visual board-based tool for managing projects and workflows. Excellent for Kanban-style task tracking.

name: Linear
description: The issue tracker for high-performance teams. Streamline software projects, sprints, and bug tracking with a focus on speed.

name: Obsidian
description: A powerful knowledge base that works on top of a local folder of plain text Markdown files. Ideal for personal knowledge management.

name: Warp
description: A modern, Rust-based terminal with AI built-in. Collaborative, fast, and works with your existing shell.

name: Arc Browser
description: The browser that helps you focus. A modern internet experience with spaces, boosts, and a powerful command bar.

name: Raycast
description: A blazingly fast, extendable launcher for Mac. Replace Spotlight with a powerful command palette for everything.
